subject: Cannot write to hdfs using rhwrite

messages.author: 90bf2cc4fa41cf4e
messages.subject: Cannot write to hdfs using rhwrite
parts:
Hi,

I am new to Rhipe.
I was trying to write data to hdfs using rhwrite.

rhwrite(a,file="hdfs://localhost:8020/x")

but it says the function is expecting  a local file system

Error in .jnew("org/godhuli/rhipe/RHWriter", as.character(file), as.integer(numperfile),  : 
  java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Wrong FS: hdfs://localhost:8020/x, expected: file:///

i disabled the permissions in hdfs-site.xml

what can be the problem. Please help

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Cannot write to hdfs using rhwrite
parts:
this could be a configuration issue.

a) try rhls("hdfs://.....")
b) just do rhls("/") - it should show the root directory of your HDFS> If it shows your local root it might be a config issue.
